verdict.rationale: Exa's docs describe Websets for async list-building/enrichment at scale, async deep research, scheduled searches, and webhook callbacks for job status — directly supporting asynchronous high-volume workloads, backed by rate-limit documentation for query volume management. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk/batch query submission endpoint (vs. Websets-specific async jobs), and independent/hands-on benchmarks confirming reliable performance at high volume.
